repository_binding.working_tree_note: The branch was dirty during this documentation-only audit. This ledger does not claim that uncommitted CLI or harness behavior is frozen.

scope.purpose: Pre-registration candidate discovery for ten computational-chemistry domains. This is a source, license, coordinate, and CLI-gap ledger; it is not a reproduction or readiness receipt.
scope.coordinate_contract: PRP-10 accepts only an exact, official, single-frame XYZ in angstrom with source/member identity, exact-byte hash, atom order, and user-approved molecular identity. Archive members are acceptable when the official archive and member are pinned. Conversion, OCR, table transcription, SMILES-to-3D, and model-generated coordinates are not acceptable for campaign eligibility.
scope.execution_ceiling: source inspection and private coordinate-byte validation only; chemistry-engine and HPC invocations are prohibited
scope.public_artifact_policy: No copyrighted full text, SI bytes, coordinate bytes, native input, API credential, or private-store path is stored in this ledger.
scope.decision_rule: A candidate is campaign_eligible only after full text and SI, license, exact coordinates, critical method facts, ChemSmart project YAML, canonical command DAG, safe preview, and deterministic review all pass. A source-ready candidate is not automatically campaign-eligible.

bibliography.result: All ten DOI/title pairs resolved as journal articles; Crossref exposed no is-corrected-by or is-retracted-by relation for these records at checked_at. This is not a substitute for later publisher and retraction-database rechecking at harness freeze.

datasets.source: Zenodo REST record endpoint or official project repository

coordinates.method: Private disposable audit of official bytes: first line atom count, exactly atom_count plus two lines, exactly one atom-count frame marker, and SHA-256. Existing public receipts are referenced when available.
coordinates.limitations: Structural syntax does not prove molecular identity, charge, multiplicity, electronic state, layer assignment, reaction-role assignment, or that every paper-essential geometry is present.

cli.method: Source inspection of command families in the bound repository only.
cli.limitations: A named CLI family is not end-to-end coverage. No project loader, command compiler, semantic round-trip, generated-input parser, or safe-preview campaign was run for these candidates.

status_vocabulary.development_candidate_cli_review_pending: Source and exact-coordinate evidence are promising, but paper-complete ChemSmart compilation has not passed.
status_vocabulary.blocked: A potentially repairable, explicitly identified eligibility condition is missing or unresolved.
status_vocabulary.rejected_for_current_campaign: The paper conflicts with the current one-system, exact-coordinate, or supported-essential-workflow selection rule; it may remain useful as a future stress test.
status_vocabulary.campaign_eligible: All source, scientific, command, preview, and review gates passed. No candidate has this status in this ledger.

summary.honest_conclusion: The ten domain slots are populated for investigation, but the PRP-10 campaign is not pre-registration-ready. The urea/W18 paper is the strongest next development candidate; all other slots have an evidence, scope, coordinate, or essential-workflow blocker.
